interpretation: Chrome is noninvariant in all eight groups; native is invariant in the four half-opacity groups and noninvariant in the four alpha-one groups. Native 4/8 is a captured classification disagreement, not a browser-compatibility improvement.
The with-P and without-P PNGs are identical for every state/scale in each renderer. R alone supplies the observed boundary.
All pair differences are on R perimeter pixels; no interior or outside-bound changes were observed.
Measured straight-edge color samples are consistent with the fractional translation within two channel levels; corner antialias behavior can still differ between rasterizers.
This is neither full antialias parity nor evidence that a nonidentical pair by itself violates a standard.
